groups.contract: Design save/load validates connected recipes and paths before writes; actual external I/O is not an implicit transaction
groups.disposition: Both whole production/fixture bodies read. Selection precedence is placement override then shared default; parse validates actual catalogue item/placement, recipe validate and historical family. encode reparses serialized output, so invalid state rejects before writing; unknown object-field check is recursive for objects, with list-specific semantics owned by actual recipe serde. DesignPaths validates all3 recipe bytes and resolves all paths/canonical aliases before any write; fixed3-array enumerate and suffix i+1 are bounded. No documented all-or-nothing I/O guarantee or actual failure scenario is established; do not transfer local validation-before-write into an atomic multi-file claim. Actual alias rejection and successful3-file round-trip fixture source read, not executed. Separate schema/catalogue parsing remains earlier owner-propagation evidence, not new numerical finding.

groups.contract: Wearer region support and lower-layer surfaces retain actual rig membership and indexed-mesh relationships
groups.disposition: Both complete bodies read. Side sign and FittingPlacement select semantic handedness; Unpaired side returns error. FitRegion lists actual canonical rig parts, with Shoulder support including clavicle and Hand including terminal finger joints. support_indices_for verifies skin/weight rows and actual source joint count against names, then sums only included member weights and applies.30 threshold. Equal counts do not establish same rig instance or numeric weight validity; existing canonical row/identity admission repair remains relevant, not a new inferred normal wearer failure. ArmorLayerSurface chooses matching direct morph positions or explicit missing-target error, rejects index remainder/empty triangles, skin row mismatch and every out-of-range index before borrowed result. It does not independently prove all float normals/weights/positions; generated product admission owns those. No neutral lower realization fallback for missing morph. Shoulder/hand fixture bodies fully read only.
